rule_or_requirement: A faster pixel-only candidate should retain valid completion on a separately reserved confirmation set.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, visible asphalt clearance, road-center motion, obstacle pixels, rendered speed, and fixed stable actor action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Run the exact frozen stable road-clearance gas gate from tune and held-out without modification.
expected_success_endpoint: At least selected control's finish count across twelve one-time confirmation cells and lower median finished lap time on tied completion, with no invalid actions.
control: Exact-hash selected full-road-guard actor on each registered confirmation cell.
falsifier: Lower finish count, invalid action, or tied completion without lower median finished lap time.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Tracks 1–3 × seeds 332–335, two frozen arms and 24 episodes at 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 1800-second registered limit, one-time confirmation only; no parameter change, blind use, package, or website action.
